(function(){var bad=[];document.querySelectorAll('svg').forEach(function(s,si){var ts=[].slice.call(s.querySelectorAll('text')).map(function(t){var b=t.getBBox();return{t:t.textContent.slice(0,12),x:b.x,y:b.y,w:b.width,h:b.height};});for(var i=0;i<ts.length;i++){for(var j=i+1;j<ts.length;j++){var a=ts[i],b=ts[j];var ox=Math.min(a.x+a.w,b.x+b.w)-Math.max(a.x,b.x);var oy=Math.min(a.y+a.h,b.y+b.h)-Math.max(a.y,b.y);if(ox>2&&oy>2)bad.push('s'+si+':"'+a.t+'"x"'+b.t+'"');}}});return bad.length?bad.slice(0,12).join(' | '):'no text overlap';})()
